question: Which Chief Justice of India was sworn in as the acting President of India on 20th July 1969 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Mohammad Hidayatullah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Justice Mohammad Hidayatullah** was sworn in as the acting President of India on 20th July 1969.
 
• Justice Hidayatullah was the Chief Justice of India from 1968 to 1970.
 
• He served as the acting President following the death of President Zakir Husain and the subsequent resignation of Vice President V. V. Giri.<
